description: This dataset contains Antarctic radar data collected during the 1997/98 season using EMR instruments. It includes twenty unique profiles, each identified by a specific Profile ID and associated with either 60 ns or 600 ns pulse radar products. The data is available in multiple formats, including netCDF files with varying sizes, GIS-compatible KML files, and image previews. Researchers can use this information to analyze ice sheet structures and subsurface features in Antarctica. The dataset supports climate and geospatial studies by providing detailed technical specifications and direct links to raw data files, facilitating comprehensive environmental monitoring and scientific investigation of polar regions.
